notes: Placed graphics are named by what they contain - 'OCHA Lower Third - John Doe', 'OCHA Gradient - Middle left half 60' - and the name follows what you type. Items with nothing to name them by are numbered (Ending 1, Ending 2). The format is no longer in the name; the sequence already tells you. Editing is solid: the panel always notices a deselect, an edit can never land on a different clip than the one it was typed for, and deselecting after typing no longer leaves a red banner behind. The Position accordion stays closed unless you open it, and the readability gradient's Middle width row is laid out properly.
